operations.name: mask.add
operations.description: Add a new mask to a layer. Returns the mask index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: mask.set_path
operations.description: Set a mask's shape path from vertices. Vertices are [x,y] pairs relative to the layer.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: inTangents
params.description: Array of [x,y] in-tangent offsets (same length as vertices)

params.name: featherSegLocs
params.description: Variable-width feather: 0-based segment index per feather point

params.name: featherRelSegLocs
params.description: Variable-width feather: relative position (0-1) on the segment, per point

params.name: featherRadii
params.description: Variable-width feather: radius in px per point. Sign must match featherTypes: outer points (type 0) need radius >= 0, inner points (type 1) need radius <= 0 — AE rejects mismatches

params.name: featherTensions
params.description: Variable-width feather: tension 0-1 per point (default all 0)

params.name: featherRelCornerAngles
params.description: Variable-width feather: relative corner angle % per point (default all 0)

operations.name: mask.set_props
operations.description: Set mask properties: mode, feather, opacity, expansion, inverted, locked, color, rotoBezier, motionBlur, featherFalloff.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: locked
params.description: Lock the mask against UI editing

params.name: color
params.description: [r,g,b] 0-1 mask outline color in the UI

params.name: rotoBezier
params.description: Treat the path as a RotoBezier (tangents auto-computed)

operations.name: mask.remove
operations.description: Remove a mask from a layer by its 1-based index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name
